items.description: A content event a trigger can fire on.

x-enumDescriptions.DOCUMENT_CHANGE: A document was created, updated, or deleted.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DOCUMENT_CHANGE: A document was created, updated, or deleted.

x-enumDescriptions.MEETS_CONDITION: The document started matching the trigger's conditions.
x-enumDescriptions.ASSIGNED: The item was assigned to someone.
x-enumDescriptions.READY_FOR_REVIEW: A draft was marked ready for review.
x-enumDescriptions.CONVERTED_TO_DRAFT: The item was converted back to a draft.
x-enumDescriptions.WEBHOOK_UPDATED: The source system sent a webhook update.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.MEETS_CONDITION: The document started matching the trigger's conditions.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.ASSIGNED: The item was assigned to someone.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.READY_FOR_REVIEW: A draft was marked ready for review.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CONVERTED_TO_DRAFT: The item was converted back to a draft.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.WEBHOOK_UPDATED: The source system sent a webhook update.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the document the event is about.

view_url.description: Link to the document in its source system.

title.description: Title of the document, or the subject for email.

event_time.description: When the event happened at the source: the document's own change timestamp for a document change, and the scheduled time for a content schedule. Omitted when the source did not supply one.

items.title: PlatformTriggerEvent

has_more.description: Whether more events matched than were returned. Raise `page_size` to see more; cursor-based paging is not offered yet.

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this request, for support and debugging.

400.description: Invalid request (malformed JSON, invalid parameter values, unknown fields).

schema.description: Error response following RFC 9457, extended with `code` and `documentation_url` for machine-readable classification and self-service remediation.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored from the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.
detail.example: The provided cursor has expired. Start a new search to get a fresh cursor.

documentation_url.description: Direct URL to documentation for this error code.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

errors.description: Field-level validation problems, one entry per offending field.

items.description: Field-level validation problem for a single offending field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending field.

detail.example: Must be one of: USER, GLEAN_AI.
